  "memo": "R08 holds because three accounts used the shipping address. Although it is the account's home, its recent registration defeats the household exception. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate new household member is plausible, competing with coordinated synthetic identities. The first order is below the category's upper-percentile reference, so R04 does not hold. No installments were due, so repayment intent cannot support action. Recommend needs_check under §6.6(b): run id_check, the required check for Linkage. No check has run, and the order remains unshipped. Address sharing alone does not permit decline or escalation here."
